name: Lamplighter
ability: Each night, you learn whether a lamp is lit.
otherNightReminder: Show the Lamplighter a lamp again.

name: Bellringer
ability: Each night except the first, ring a bell. If anyone is drunk, it rings twice.

name: Whisperer
ability: On your first night, whisper to one player.
firstNightReminder: The Whisperer points at a player.

name: Hollow King
ability: Each night except the first, choose a player: they die.
otherNightReminder: The Hollow King points at a player. That player dies.

name: Cartographer
ability: Once per game, draw a map.
